name: WebStudio
description: Cria páginas web e mostra o site sendo montado ao vivo no Studio.

details.about: O WebStudio monta sites estáticos, em HTML e CSS, dentro do Studio: a conversa fica à esquerda e o site aparece à direita, parte por parte, enquanto o agente trabalha. Cada página fica disponível na faixa de páginas, embaixo da prévia.
features: Monta o site seção por seção, com prévia ao vivo
Prévia no tamanho de computador e de celular
Abre o site pronto no navegador
limitations: Gera sites estáticos, sem banco de dados nem formulários que enviam dados
A publicação ainda não está disponível nesta versão
Imagens são desenhos em SVG ou CSS; fotos da internet não são baixadas
examples: Crie um site para a minha cafeteria, com cardápio, horário e botão de reserva
Adicione uma página de contato com endereço e WhatsApp
Troque as cores do site por tons de verde
details.author: JumpCode

instructions: Build and edit the website shown live in the Studio preview. Work in small steps so the user sees the site grow: one call per section, each html or css under 3000 characters. For a new site: first write_styles name 'base' (colors, fonts, spacing, layout), then write_section for page 'index' in reading order (for example header, hero, features, footer), passing the page title on the first section. A section is one complete HTML element such as <header>, <section> or <footer>; never send <html>, <head> or <body>. The stylesheet is linked automatically. Each style block is replaced as a whole: keep 'base' for the global look and put the rules of a new section in a new block named after that section. Link pages with href="index.html" or href="<page>.html". Use read before changing an existing site (page for HTML, page plus section for one section, name for CSS; if the result contains next, call read with those exact arguments until no next remains before replacing the content), write_section with an existing id to replace it, and remove_section or remove_page to delete. Draw images with inline SVG or CSS; do not use external scripts, fonts or images. After the last change, always answer the user in one short sentence saying what changed.

action.description: write_section creates or replaces one section of a page; write_styles creates or replaces one CSS block; remove_section and remove_page delete; read returns the site outline, one page's sections (page), one section (page and section), or CSS (name). Large results return next arguments to continue the same version without omissions.

page.description: Page id: 'index' for the home page or a short lowercase name such as 'cardapio' or 'contato'. Defaults to 'index'.

section.description: Section id for writing, removing, or reading one section of a page; a short lowercase name such as 'header', 'hero', 'menu' or 'footer'.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation returned in next by read. Reuse next exactly; do not invent or edit the cursor.

html.description: HTML of the section: one complete element such as <section>...</section>.

title.description: Optional page title shown in the browser tab.

name.description: Style block name, such as 'base' or 'menu'. Defaults to 'base' when writing; pass name with read to retrieve its CSS, following next when present.

css.description: CSS rules for the style block.
